$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (observability-connection-run-summary). Adds alertThresholds to source and synchronization and declares connection_alert, the alert ConnectionThresholdJob opens when a count passes a threshold and clears when it falls back. The warning is declarative: a created rule on connection_alert notifies the members of the group named in the app setting connection_alert_group (ConnectionAlertRecipientResolver). No group is set by default, so nobody is notified until an administrator names one. See openspec/changes/observability-connection-run-summary/design.md D4 and D5.

connection_alert.title: Connection alert
connection_alert.summary: A source or synchronization passed one of its alert thresholds
connection_alert.description: Opened by the threshold job when a count of failures passes a threshold, and cleared when the count falls back. While an alert is open for a subject and rule, no second one opens, so a source failing all night warns once.

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: Whether the threshold belongs to a source or a synchronization.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The id of the source or synchronization.

subjectName.title: Name
subjectName.description: The name of the source or synchronization when the alert opened.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: What was counted: failed calls, failed runs or invalid objects.

count.title: Count
count.description: The count in the window when the alert opened.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: The count the threshold allows; the alert opened above it.

state.title: State
state.description: Open while the count stays above the threshold, cleared once it falls back.

clearedAt.title: Cleared at
clearedAt.description: When the count fell back and the alert cleared.
